text:
marta: quick preflight for tonight's coverage — leaving a short watchlist and a couple of asks before i sign off :wave:

marta: Known non-blocking items to keep an eye on:
- decoder-pool: occasional backpressure spikes during long-chat tails (seen 2x in last 6h). root cause still noisy memory growth on model-x instances.
- kv-prefetch: ~0.5% increased latency on cold prefixes in eu-west, affects a few customer lanes.
- metrics-exporter: intermittent 503s from the exporter (<5m windows) — hasn't impacted ingest but increases retries.

marta: FYI i'm not escalating anything yet, just flagging so the night crew is aware. If decoder-pool queue > 150 for >5m, escalate to oncall-sre.

alex: thanks for the summary. quick q: what's the current workaround for decoder-pool pressure?

marta: short answer: temporarily bump decoder-worker count on the affected pool and enable soft-throttle for long requests. put a note in the rollout: `./deploy scale decoder-pool --count 24 --soft-throttle true`

jia: copying the runbook link for prefetch and exporter: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metrics-exporter — both have checklists for nightly confirmation.

ryan: i'll be onwatch 23:00-03:00. if decoder-pool spikes i'll try the scale command first, then DM @sre-lead if it persists.

marta: perfect. also, small config ask: please don't change quantization-profile on prod models during coverage hours unless coordinated. last change introduced a tiny bump in request variance.

oncall-bot: automated alert subscription: decoder-pool-queue-length, kv-prefetch-p95-latency, exporter-5xx-rate were added to #eng-oncall for tonight.

ryan: noted. i'll mute low-priority prefix-cache alerts that are known noisy signals (prefix-cache-prefetch-warning) and leave the p95/p99 thresholds active.

alex: pushing a tiny PR to lower exporter retry window (link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7821) — can someone give a quick review? it's tiny, 2 lines.

jia: on it, will review in next 10.

marta: handoff note: i'm switching pager to saturday morning. if anything looks like a real regression (error rates sustained above baseline for >10m), please page me and @sre-lead. otherwise route through the normal #eng-oncall flow.

ryan: quick reminder to whoever takes over after me — the EU prefetch cluster has an automated drain scheduled at 01:30 to rotate nodes. plan for ~3min of elevated kv latency during that window.

alex: thanks, i'll add a short comment in the rotation calendar and pin it to tonight's thread.

jia: PR reviewed, approved. alex — feel free to merge when you're ready.

marta: final checklist before i go:
- ensure oncall config includes decoder-pool alert + escalation (confirmed)
- mute known noisy prefix-cache channel alerts (ryan to do)
- reviewer for exporter PR (jia confirmed)
- note scheduled EU prefetch drain at 01:30 (ryan noted)

marta: leaving status: oncall handoff complete. ping me if anything unexpected pops up. :v:
